WorldObjectDef.label: delegation
WorldObjectDef.description: A diplomatic party on the road: envoys, sometimes a leader, and their escort. A caravan of yours on the same tile can intercept it, which is an act of war.

WorldObjectDef.label: warband
WorldObjectDef.description: An army on the march. It besieges, blockades or raids when it arrives. A caravan of yours on the same tile can intercept it; if you are not already at war with its faction, that is an act of war.
